name: Harinder Cheema

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Harinder Cheema is a poet and author whose books include The Temple Stop and Soul Chants. In an interview about her writing, she spoke of literature’s relationship with society and of the need to look beyond personal gain towards a shared good.

‘At the Time of Homecoming’, her poem in Kabita Live, imagines earthly life as a school day and the Creator as a parent waiting at home. Its familiar images of play, rules and a clean uniform frame a moral question: what kind of life will we have lived when it is time to return?
